name: LMSubs
description: OpenAI-compatible ASR (speech-to-text) + LLM subtitle translation. Works like OpenSubtitles: search and download 'LM Subtitles' in the Edit Subtitles dialog; the server generates the full subtitle, which Jellyfin then saves and registers. Provider presets plus configurable Base URL / API Key / Model. Completed results are cached. No web modification.
overview: ASR transcription + LLM subtitle translation (OpenSubtitles-style download flow)

versions.changelog: Remove dead ASR concurrency setting. Debounce duplicate download clicks (no duplicate subtitle tracks). Plugin-only Log level setting with Debug process logs (per ASR chunk / translation batch).
ASR shared across target languages: one transcription per item, second language reuses transcript and progress (translation-only cost). Per-language translations run in parallel.
Fix ffmpeg not found: use Jellyfin's resolved encoder/probe paths (IMediaEncoder) instead of bare 'ffmpeg', which is not on PATH in the official container.

Search entry renamed to 'LM Subtitles' with model/target details in the description. Target language comes from the search dialog language (setting removed). Re-search while generating shows live ASR/Translate progress percentages.
Target Jellyfin 10.11 (.NET 9). Fixes MissingMethodException on search when running on 10.11 servers (GetItemList signature changed).
Fix 'no results' in Edit Subtitles search: register provider as ISubtitleProvider (SubtitleManager resolves IEnumerable<ISubtitleProvider>).
Settings page: Advanced section single column; clearer translation-toggle label.
OpenSubtitles-style flow: generate via Edit Subtitles -> search -> download; full sequential generation; removed injected tracks and playback-event triggers; REST API retained.
